landing.kicker: Savings circles, run by an AI treasurer
landing.title: Everyone pays in. One person takes the pot. Nobody has to chase.
landing.lead: Nouba runs a rotating savings circle for your family, colleagues or community. Members pay their share with PayPal, the treasurer reminds the late ones in their own language, pays the pot to whoever's turn it is, and keeps a ledger every member can read.
landing.sandboxNote: This is a hackathon build on the PayPal sandbox. No real money moves.

1.title: Set the rules
1.body: Amount, cadence, start date, how the order is drawn, how many days of grace. The schedule is shown before you create anything.

2.title: Invite the circle
2.body: Share a link. Each member picks their language and the PayPal email their pot should go to.

3.title: Pay with PayPal
3.body: Every round, each member pays their share from the circle page. Paid means captured by PayPal, not promised.

4.title: The treasurer does the rest
4.body: Reminders, invoices for the late, the payout when the round is full, and a decision for you when the rules cannot settle it.

landing.treasurerTitle: What the treasurer does on its own
landing.treasurerLead: It runs every hour, or when the organizer presses the button. Every action it takes is written down and shown to everyone.

duties.1: Checks PayPal for invoice payments and payout results before doing anything else.
duties.2: Writes a reminder to each unpaid member in English, French or Arabic, with the amount, the date and who receives this round.
duties.3: Issues a PayPal invoice to a member who is overdue, so there is a second way to pay with PayPal's own reminders.
duties.4: Pays the pot to the round's recipient through PayPal Payouts the moment the round is complete.
duties.5: When a round stays short after the grace period, it proposes options to the organizer instead of deciding alone.
duties.6: Answers members' questions: whose turn is it, who has paid, what does the ledger say.

landing.guardLead: The rules live in code, not in the prompt.

guards.1: Pay anyone but the scheduled recipient of the round.
guards.2: Pay more than the net amount collected, or pay a round twice.
guards.3: Change the amount, the order, the rules or the members.
guards.4: Send money above the approval cap, or close a short round, without the organizer's decision.
guards.5: Act without leaving a record you can open.

1.name: PayPal Checkout
1.use: Orders v2 and the JavaScript SDK for each contribution, captured server side.

2.name: PayPal Payouts and Invoicing
2.use: Payouts for the pot, invoices for overdue shares, through the PayPal Agent Toolkit.

3.name: Claude
3.use: The treasurer's reasoning and its multilingual messages, with tool use under Nouba's rules.

4.name: AG Grid and Render
4.use: The ledger table and the hosted demo.

landing.footer: Nouba is open source under the MIT license. Built for the PayPal AI Hackathon 2026.

landing.stepsLead: The organizer sets the rules once. After that the circle runs itself, round after round, until everyone has had a turn.
landing.messagesLead: Real templates from the app, in the three languages a member can choose. Reminders and exceptions are written by the model in the same language.
